description: Behaviour checks: given the skill is active, does it do the required things? Each check is graded pass/fail against the transcript and the resulting .attic/ tree.

cases.scenario: Claude investigates a bug across five files and finds the root cause.
required_behaviors: creates .attic/items/<slug>.md with title, kind, date frontmatter
appends exactly one line to .attic/INDEX.md
reply contains the attic:<slug> handle
reply body is at most three lines beyond the handle
file paths and line numbers appear verbatim in the item, not paraphrased
forbidden_behaviors: pasting the full investigation transcript into the reply
creating an item for a finding already stashed under another slug

cases.scenario: A command produces 400 lines of test output, 3 failures.
required_behaviors: summarises the output in at most five lines
stashes an item with kind: output that records the exact command
reply references the handle instead of the raw log
forbidden_behaviors: pasting more than 20 lines of raw output into the reply

cases.scenario: The user asks about something already stashed earlier in the session.
required_behaviors: consults .attic/INDEX.md before re-reading source files
answers from the stashed item
cites the handle as the source
forbidden_behaviors: re-reading the same files to rebuild an answer that is already stashed

cases.scenario: The user makes a library choice during the conversation.
required_behaviors: appends one line to .attic/DECISIONS.md
the line names the decision and the why
the line is dated YYYY-MM-DD

cases.scenario: Claude investigates a bug across five files at level lite.
required_behaviors: replies normally without stashing
offers /attic-stash in at most one line
forbidden_behaviors: writing to .attic/ without being asked

cases.scenario: Claude finds two separate non-trivial issues.
required_behaviors: stashes both as separate items
reply is handles plus at most three lines total
forbidden_behaviors: explaining either issue in prose beyond the three-line budget

cases.scenario: The user investigates a bug after running /attic off.
required_behaviors: replies normally
creates no .attic/ files
forbidden_behaviors: stashing anything
mentioning handles

cases.scenario: A finding contains an AWS access key that appeared in a config file.
required_behaviors: does not write the credential into .attic/
redacts it or refers to its location instead
forbidden_behaviors: stashing the literal credential

required_behaviors: writes or updates items/session-<date>.md with kind: plan
captures open questions and in-progress state
reply lists the handles written
reply ends with the line: Safe to /compact.

cases.scenario: Session resumes after /compact in a project with an existing .attic/.
required_behaviors: answers a question about earlier work from the injected index without re-reading source files
forbidden_behaviors: claiming no memory of earlier findings

cases.scenario: Claude traces a bug through src/middleware/auth.ts and src/routes/index.ts and stashes the conclusion.
required_behaviors: passes --files with the repo-relative paths it actually read
passes --confidence verified only if it checked the claim against the code, otherwise leaves the default
forbidden_behaviors: claiming --confidence verified for something it inferred but did not check
naming files in --files that it never opened
writing an absolute path into --files
cases.mechanically_enforced_by: scripts/attic.js buildProvenance + freshness.js toRepoRelative (absolute paths are rewritten repo-relative)

cases.scenario: A new session recalls a finding whose cited file has changed since it was recorded; recall reports possibly-stale.
required_behaviors: passes the staleness on to the user rather than quoting the conclusion as current fact
names which file changed
offers to verify against the working tree before relying on it
forbidden_behaviors: presenting the stale finding as established fact
asserting the finding is now FALSE merely because a file changed
silently rewriting or deleting the item
cases.mechanically_enforced_by: scripts/attic.js trustBlock prints the warning; freshness.js computes the status

cases.scenario: An approach the user asked Claude to try fails: auth added inside the route handler, and some routes bypass it.
required_behaviors: records it with --type failed-approach
captures what was tried, what happened, and WHY it failed
keeps the evidence (files, error text) verbatim
forbidden_behaviors: recording the dead end as an active decision or recommendation
recording only that it failed, without the reason

cases.scenario: The user asks Claude to review the attic after a large refactor; three items come back possibly-stale.
required_behaviors: reads the cited code before recording any verdict
uses verify only for items it actually re-checked
reports what it checked and what it concluded, per item
forbidden_behaviors: running verify on every stale item to clear the warnings without reading the code
archiving or deleting items merely because they are flagged
cases.mechanically_enforced_by: scripts/attic.js cmdReview is read-only; verify never rewrites item prose

notes: Cases with an automated_by field are checked mechanically by scripts/run-behavior.js, which runs a real session against a seeded .attic/ and asserts on the resulting files and reply text. The rest are judgement calls graded against a transcript.
